headline: The Weeknd Donates $2.2M From 2026 Tour to Fight Hunger and Fund Education
meta_description: The Weeknd's 2026 European and UK tour will generate $2.2 million for the UN World Food Programme and Global Citizen, supporting education and food security.
summary_short: The Weeknd is channeling proceeds from his 2026 European and UK tour toward global hunger relief and education, with £1 or €1 per ticket going directly to those causes.
body:
The Weeknd has committed $2.2 million from his 2026 European and UK tour to the UN World Food Programme and Global Citizen. The donation mechanism is simple yet powerful: for every ticket sold, £1 or €1 will fund education for children and address urgent food security needs worldwide.

This approach transforms concert attendance into direct humanitarian impact. Rather than a one-time lump sum, the artist has structured the giving to scale with tour reach—meaning every show across Europe and the UK becomes a fundraising moment for vulnerable populations.

The partnership with both the UN World Food Programme and Global Citizen reflects a dual commitment: tackling immediate hunger crises while building long-term resilience through education. For concertgoers, purchasing a ticket becomes an act of participation in addressing global food insecurity and expanding educational access for children in need.

£1 or €1 from every ticket supports education and food security
UN World Food Programme and Global Citizen are the partner organizations
